narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: the two impossible bodies of the chapter together on the dark specimen stage - the elephant-massed runner and the great winged predator - posed so their scale and slender build read at a glance as the puzzle the chapter solves.
subject: Two complete Pandoran animals presented together on a dark naturalist stage: a tall six-limbed direhorse standing in profile, elephantine in bulk yet carried on strikingly slender legs, long neck lowered; and behind and above it a mountain banshee with its great membranous wings half-spread, the wing-frame thin and elegant. Both bodies show the faint internal glow of light, carbon-threaded bone beneath the skin.
scene: A dark museum specimen space, both creatures floating as if posed for display, deep haze beyond, no ground clutter.
camera: A clean three-quarter display view, the direhorse largest and nearest, the banshee rising behind with wings catching the light.
light: Bioluminescent key glowing from within the skeletal frames and along the wing membranes, cyan and teal; deep indigo shadow throughout; one scarce warm amber accent.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal glow in the bodies and wings, a single restrained amber accent.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, confident focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the direhorse's slender legs and long neck and the banshee's thin wing-frame; softer toward the edges; background dissolving into haze.
composition: Strong near figure (direhorse) lower-centre, the banshee rising upper-left with spread wings, generous dark negative space, 3:2 landscape.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from within the specimens. Same dark glowing-specimen mood as the established chapter covers.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
